title: Hong Kong and Bali Holiday Package
highlights: Immerse yourself in vibrant cultures and admire stunning landscapes with our Hong Kong and Bali holiday packages, offering a perfect blend of adventure and relaxation.
Visit the Ocean Park in Hong Kong to experience thrilling rides and encounter diverse wildlife across various themed zones like The Waterfront or The Summit.
Enjoy a ride on the famous Bali Swing, strategically placed to offer stunning views of Bali's natural beauty, including rice terraces, dense forests, and volcanic landscapes.
Explore Nusa Penida’s Kelingking Beach, known for its T-Rex-shaped cliffs, offering dramatic ocean views, perfect for photographs.
overview:
About the destinations:
Travellers choosing our Hong Kong and Bali holiday packages can experience a rich array of destinations. Hong Kong offers a dynamic blend of iconic skyscrapers, bustling markets, and attractions like Ocean Park, showcasing its vibrant culture. Bali’s Ubud is known for its tranquil rice terraces and artistic charm, providing a serene escape. The Kintamani Highlands feature stunning landscapes and panoramic views, while Kuta is home to sacred temples and the playful Ubud Monkey Forest. The pristine beaches of Nusa Penida Island add a perfect touch of relaxation, making these Hong Kong Bali package deals truly unforgettable.

know_before_you_go: Kindly carry a valid photo ID proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
Images are for representation purpose only.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your shoulders and knees covered) when visiting any religious sites and temples.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.

There are no mandatory vaccinations for visitors to Bali (barring the need for travellers arriving from countries with a high yellow fever transmission risk to carry a yellow fever vaccination certificate), although Hepatitis A, typhoid and tetanus are often recommended.
The official currency of Bali is the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases.

While credit card and/or digital payments are widely accepted in Hong Kong, it is recommended that you carry enough cash for small purchases as well. You can purchase or rent an Octopus Card, a widely accepted mode of digital payment in the city.
Hong Kong’s weather is pleasant most of the time and doesn’t experience extremes, as it is subtropical. It does get quite humid in summer and cool in winter, so pack accordingly for those swings.
It is advised that you carry an electrical adaptor. Hong Kong uses the UK-style plug, which is three-pronged.

As per Indian Govt. rules, a Tax Collection at Source (TCS) of 5% for Foreign Remittance shall be paid additionally that you can claim while filing the income tax returns. Kindly consult a tax advisor/consultant for further information.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hong Kong | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Hong Kong! Upon arrival at the airport, you'll be transferred to your hotel for check-in. Take the day to explore the city at your leisure. Visit the serene Nan Lian Garden, a beautiful oasis in the heart of the bustling city, or head to the Sky 100 Observation Deck for stunning views of the skyline. You might also enjoy a visit to Madame Tussauds to meet lifelike figures of your favourite celebrities. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Hong Kong Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Immerse yourself in the highlights of Hong Kong on a sightseeing tour. Start in Tsim Sha Tsui, where you can explore the historic 1881 Heritage, showcasing the city's colonial past. Visit The School, a unique cultural space, and wander through the vibrant streets of Yaumatei, stopping at the beautiful Yaumatei Tin Hau Temple. Stroll through the West Kowloon Art Park, enjoying its artistic installations and waterfront views. Afterwards, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Ocean Park
days.desc: Spend an exhilarating day at Ocean Park, Hong Kong's premier theme park. Experience thrilling rides, animal exhibits, and marine shows. Explore the park's two main areas: the thrill-seeking rides in the AdventureLand and the marine attractions in the Waterfront. Don’t miss the Giant Panda Adventure to see these adorable creatures up close. After the visit, you will be transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Ocean Park Hong Kong Tickets - Ocean Park Hong Kong - 1 Day Pass

days.title: Transfer to Ubud | Leisure Day
days.desc: After an exhilarating time in Hong Kong, check out and get transferred to the airport for a flight (tickets not included) to Ubud in Bali. Upon reaching, you will be transferred to the hotel for check in. You can take the day to relax at the hotel or explore Ubud on your own. Visit Ubud Art Market, see various birds at Bali Bird Park, or simply enjoy a leisurely walk through rice paddies. After the exploration, head back to the hotel and enjoy your overnight stay.

days.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, embark on a scenic adventure to the Kintamani Highlands, where breathtaking views of Mount Batur await. Stop at the iconic Tegallalang Rice Terraces to marvel at the lush, tiered landscapes. Continue to Tegenungan Waterfall for a refreshing swim or a relaxing time by the cascading waters. Take in the unparalleled views below from the famous Bali Swing as you soar above dense forests. Afterwards, get transferred to the hotel in Ubud for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Kuta | Bali Temple Tour with Monkey Forest
days.desc: Check out and travel to Kuta. Upon reaching, visit the Alas Kedaton Monkey Forest, where playful macaques roam among ancient temples. Also, visit the beautiful Taman Ayun Temple, known for its stunning gardens and architecture. Continue your temple tour at the majestic Tanah Lot Temple, perched on a cliff, offering breathtaking ocean views. After the tour ends, you will be transferred to your hotel in Kuta. Check in and enjoy your overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Nusa Penida Island
days.desc: Take a thrilling day trip to Nusa Penida Island, known for its dramatic landscapes and crystal-clear waters. Visit iconic spots like Kelingking Beach, famous for its stunning cliffs and turquoise waves, and explore the pristine shores of Broken Beach and Angel's Billabong. Enjoy snorkelling opportunities (extra cost) to witness vibrant marine life in the clear waters. After this adventurous day, you will be transferred back to the hotel in Kuta for an overnight stay.
